races.title: Hope House Children's Hospices Conditional Jockeys' Training Series Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Quite a difficult race to assess with MALINAS GLORY just about the most persuasive option on the back of a more encouraging effort back hurdling at Hereford with a good-value conditional also booked. Cahier's Den should run closer to form this time, with Eaststone Buck's another to consider on his reappearance. MALINAS GLORY (IRE) CAHIER'S DEN (IRE) EASTSTONE BUCK'S

races.title: Wrexham Lager Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Bumper winners POINTOFDIFFERENCE and Cool Customer ought to come to the fore here. The latter has the benefit of experience over obstacles but the former looked useful last month so is marginally preferred. Point recruit Koaly Play also needs considering. POINTOFDIFFERENCE COOL CUSTOMER (IRE) KOALY PLAY (IRE)

races.title: Howard Evans Roofing & Cladding Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This looks an interesting race but Henry Daly has his string in good order and TRINITY STREET has all the hallmarks of one who will take to fences. She therefore receives the vote in favour of Twistthenightaway and Pottersville . TRINITY STREET (IRE) TWISTTHENIGHTAWAY (IRE) POTTERSVILLE (IRE)

races.title: Paul Ferguson Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict: SCOTT'S LEGACY wasn't up to Grade 2 company at Cheltenham but could be a cut above back in a lower grade. Donald McCain point winner Works For Me is one who might give him something to think about, while Trojan Tale is surely better than he showed on his first attempt over hurdles. SCOTT'S LEGACY (IRE) WORKS FOR ME (IRE) TROJAN TALE (IRE)

races.title: Paul Ferguson Jumpers To Follow Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict: HANG OUT is the percentage call on the back of his recent C&D hurdle debut success. Loki achieved enough on the Flat to think he should be able to make his presence felt at this level over hurdles, while Written in Gold is a newcomer who would enter calculations if the betting speaks in his favour. HANG OUT (IRE) LOKI (GER) WRITTEN IN GOLD (IRE)

races.title: Follow Dave Win 60th Birthday Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: DOCTORS HILL made a pleasing start to his chase career at Ffos Las and is given a chance to build on that promise, particularly as hat-trick seeker Royal Mer has peak fitness to prove after a break. Ben Pauling chase newcomer The Hawkstonian and Venetia Williams French recruit Luron d'Oudairies are other interesting runners. DOCTORS HILL ROYAL MER (FR) THE HAWKSTONIAN (IRE)

races.title: Pennine Flooring On The Radio Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: GASMANI shaped promisingly on his chasing debut when runner-up over this C&D a month ago, form which has been working out well, and he can build on that effort to go one better. Big Cadillac isn't taken lightly, though, having made a successful start to his chasing career, with The Price of Peace one to note for last year's winning yard. GASMANI (IRE) BIG CADILLAC (IRE) THE PRICE OF PEACE (IRE)
